SELECT DISTINCT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  boat
FROM schedule
WHERE cls = 'day_1_5' 
  AND fish_date_doy IN (287, 293, 295)
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, boat

SELECT 
  boat,
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'day_1_5'
  AND boat IN ('Ranger 85', 'Pacific Voyager', 'Tomahawk', 'Sea Adventure 80')
  AND fish_date_doy >= 280
GROUP BY boat, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
